//: Neither platform-espressif32 nor the pioarduino fork ships a board for the
Heltec Wireless Paper, which is why `board = heltec_wireless_paper` in the
original platformio.ini failed with UnknownBoard. Every value here is taken
from Heltec's own boards.txt in Heltec-Aaron-Lee/WiFi_Kit_series, so it says
what the Arduino IDE would say for the same board.
Two of them are worth noticing. bootloader_addr is 0x0, not the 0x1000 used
by the original ESP32 — get that wrong and the merged image flashes cleanly
and boots into nothing. And cdc_on_boot is 0: Serial goes to UART0 and out
through the USB-serial bridge, which is where the LORA_DEBUG trace has to
land. The old build_flags forced it to 1, which would have routed the whole
serial trace to the native USB CDC instead.
name: Heltec Wireless Paper
